title: Cancellation Percentages and Change Charges by Private Event & Banquet Services Package
content:
Every Private Event & Banquet Services package prints its own free-cancellation window, its own three cancellation percentages and its own charges for moving a confirmed event.

| Package | Cancellation carries no charge at, calendar days before the event | Between ninety and thirty days, per cent | Between thirty and seven days, per cent | Inside seven days, per cent | Date move charge, USD | Date moves a booking may take | Venue move charge, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 2 | 0 | 25 | 50 | 0 | 2 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 7 | 10 | 35 | 75 | 75 | 2 | 125 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 21 | 20 | 50 | 85 | 250 | 1 | 400 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 45 | 30 | 60 | 90 | 600 | 1 | 900 |
| Gala Reception Package | 90 | 40 | 70 | 100 | 1500 | 1 | 2100 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 120 | 50 | 75 | 100 | 3200 | 1 | 4500 |

The first column is the calendar days before the event at which a cancellation carries no charge. The three percentage columns are the charge for a cancellation between ninety and thirty days before the event, between thirty and seven days, and inside seven days, each as a percentage of the contracted event value. The date move charge and the venue move charge are administration charges for moving a confirmed event to another date and to another venue. The remaining column is the number of date moves a booking may take before it is treated as a cancellation.

## How the figures sit against one another

The percentages rise inside each package as the event draws nearer, and rise across the packages at every band: 25 per cent between thirty and seven days on the Meeting Room Refreshment Package against 75 per cent on the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package. Two packages reach 100 per cent inside seven days, the Gala Reception Package and the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package.

On the Meeting Room Refreshment Package the ninety-to-thirty-days percentage is 0 and both change charges are 0, the only package on which moving a confirmed event carries no administration charge at all. Only that package and the Boardroom Reception Package allow 2 date moves; the other four allow 1.

The free-cancellation window and the venue move charge run the same way across the schedule, 2 days and 0 on the Meeting Room Refreshment Package up to 120 days and 4500 on the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package.
